capabilities: Mark text with double braces or red/orange color
Cover the note with a draggable, resizable red sheet
Hide all marks with a full-note red filter
Peek at covered marks on hover
extras: Interface is limited to English and Portuguese, following Obsidian's language setting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to cover parts of a note to test recall while studying.
summary: Study tool that hides red-marked text behind a draggable red sheet or red filter to test recall using the Japanese red sheet technique.
